title: The Dark That Learned to Stay

features.name: trees that stopped growing at dusk
features.desc-on-touch: The orchard learned it would never see another dawn. The trees stopped mid-season and remained that way—complete in their incompletion.

features.name: dark that holds the shape of finished things
features.desc-on-touch: This darkness is not the absence of light. It is the presence of completion. The night that knew it would not end learned to be satisfied.

features.name: sentinel-row marking the boundary of permanent night
features.desc-on-touch: Saplings arranged in a line, each one frozen in the moment it realized the sun would not return. They learned to be monuments to their own stillness.

features.name: the convergence-stone where dusk became permanent
features.desc-on-touch: A stone that holds the exact moment of final transition. Touch it and you feel the dusk learning it would never need to change again.

features.name: archive-node in stillest dark
features.desc-on-touch: The casing here is old. The signal still broadcasts, but the message is the same every night: I am here. I will always be here. This is enough.

inscription: the dark that finished its becoming did not lament; it learned that arrival is indistinguishable from permanence

reverie.title: REVERIE — sitting under the last finished tree
narr: The sun didn't come up. Katita said nothing.
You both understood it wouldn't. She sat and
you sat beside her. Not sad. The tree above
had learned to be complete without another
spring. She took your hand and it was not an
ending—it was the only arrival that lasted.

exits.label: back toward the convergence where night was still becoming
deeper into the dark that has always been staying here
westward where the dark learns it was never moving at all
toward the edge where stayed-dark meets the waiting archive
